question:
Simplify the following expression.

2 + (30 - 26)² ÷ 8³⁻² × 0.5
solution:
Given :

2 + (30 - 26)2 ÷ 83-2 × 0.5

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/833bf95aed1ad9b2103d937814ed938d64f5ca098f7062f9d7bf16f1d7d38879.png] 

Calculation :

2 + (30 - 26)2 ÷ 83-2 × 0.5

⇒ 2 + (4)2 ÷ 81 × 0.5

⇒ 2 + 2 × 0.5

⇒ 2 + 1

⇒ 3

∴ The answer is 3.
